meaning: Completed fixed-seed scratch screens and their faithful controls; no production-gate winner.

gate.pass_rule: 8 of 8 modes and HQ >= 0.9 at each of five terminal checks
gate.continuation_rule: uninterrupted training, fixed original noise horizon, every dense live check passes
